{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print("Shape before deduplication:", df.shape)

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print("Shape after deduplication:", df_dedup.shape)

# Check the distribution of severity
print("\nSeverity distribution:")
df_dedup['severity'].value_counts()

# Check for missing values in biomarker
print("\nMissing biomarker values:")
df_dedup['baseline_biomarker'].isnull().sum()"}
